sources: https://www.sam.usace.army.mil/Missions/Civil-Works/Recreation/Allatoona-Lake/Camping/Victoria-Campground/ (Corps page, read in the browser: plain HTTP 403s), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $30 a night at a standard electric/water site, $34 at the premium waterfront sites (13, 14, 17, 19, 21-26, 47-56); the same in 2026 and 2027. The one tent-only site (11) is $24.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232730/rates (Peak Season 2026-03-12..2026-10-17 and 2027-03-11..2027-10-23: STANDARD ELECTRIC 30, RV ELECTRIC / premium 34, tent 24); per-site price_range in https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A232730 (51 sites $30, 20 sites $34, 1 tent-only site $24); premium/waterfront site list from the April 2026 campground map PDF, read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: https://www.sam.usace.army.mil/Missions/Civil-Works/Recreation/Allatoona-Lake/Camping/Victoria-Campground/ ('71 single sites with electrical hookups (50 amp), water ...'); https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A232730 (all 71 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites 'Electricity Hookup' 50, 'Water Hookup' Y; no sewer attribute), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 75 numbered sites, all but tent-only site 11 with 50 A electric and water; 71 are bookable on recreation.gov (driveways 30-80 ft, so all take a 23-ft rig; 27 pull-throughs). The Corps lists 2 sites with sewer too, but no bookable site carries sewer.

sites.source: https://www.sam.usace.army.mil/Missions/Civil-Works/Recreation/Allatoona-Lake/Camping/Victoria-Campground/ ('The campgrounds feature 75 campsites ... 71 single sites with electrical hookups (50 amp), water ... 2 sites with electrical hookups (50 amp), water, sewer hookups ... 2 handicapped accessible sites'); campground map PDF 2026-04 ('Site Only 11 ... Site Only: No Water/Electric'); https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A232730 ('Max Vehicle Length' 30-80, 'Driveway Entry' 45 Back-In / 27 Pull-Through), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://www.sam.usace.army.mil/Missions/Civil-Works/Recreation/Allatoona-Lake/Camping/Victoria-Campground/ ('two shower houses, two restrooms, coin laundry, a swimming beach, a playground, a dump station'); recreation.gov 232730 ('flush toilets and showers are all provided'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Seasonal, roughly mid-March to mid-October. 2026: last night October 17, no dates offered November-February; 2027 dates read 'Not Available' through March 10 and are not yet released after that.

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/232730/month (Oct 2026: Reserved through the night of 10-17, nothing after; Nov 2026 - Feb 2027: no dates at any site; Mar 2027: 'Not Available' 03-01..03-10 at all 72 sites), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Two-night weekend and three-night holiday-weekend minimums; 14 nights in any 30 across the Corps' Allatoona campgrounds. Everyone checks in at the gatehouse; gate closed 10:30 pm - 7 am; three vehicles per site; check-in 4 pm (7 am if the site is empty), check-out 3 pm.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232730 (rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 nights 'Rolling 30 Days'; notices 'Entrance gate is closed from 10:30 p.m. to 7 a.m.', 'Maximum of three vehicles per campsite', 'Camping limit is 14 consecutive days or 14 non-consecutive days in any 30-day period'); Corps page ('All campers and visitors must be registered and check in through the gatehouse', 'Checkout Time is 3 p.m.', 'Check-In time ... 4 p.m., however if the site is not occupied patrons may check in as early as 7 a.m.'), read 2026-10-29

note: USACE Mobile District campground on Allatoona Lake near Woodstock, with a boat ramp, dock and swim beach; the premium sites (13, 14, 17, 19, 21-26, 47-56) are the waterfront ones. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov 232730 + Corps page: fees 24-34 -> 30-34 (24 was the tent-only site; $30 standard, $34 premium waterfront, same 2027). 50 A + water confirmed, no sewer at bookable sites; count 74 confirmed (75 numbered, site 11 tent-only), max 80, pull-through confirmed; facilities + laundry; season seasonal, closes 10-17 (calendar; the note's 'early May to early Oct' was wrong); booking url, 2/3-night minimums, 14-night max. Pin within ~135 m of the site centroid. 10 sites tagged Lakefront, 18 premium/waterfront: stored lakefront stands. Note cleaned.
flags: Phone missing -> (770) 928-8906 (recreation.gov: 'This location is staffed. Please call (770) 928-8906 to speak with local staff'); recreation.gov's facility phone 678-721-6700 is the Allatoona Lake project office.

2027 calendar reads 'Closed' at all 72 sites from March 11 (when the 2027 peak rate season starts) through May, after 'Not Available' March 1-10. McKinney (232715, the same Corps office) shows exactly the same pattern, and neither page posts a closure notice, so this reads as the district's 2027 season not yet opened for sale, not a closure; opening date therefore left out. Worth a recheck in the spring.
